system.biography:
A master of small-unit tactics, the ultimate tactical commander, employed by megacorporations for sensitive field work. Usually gives the orders, but perfectly capable of dealing with you personally.

Augmented (applied): body 4 (10), quickness 4 (8), strength 3 (7), intelligence 5 (7), reaction 3 (8).

Initiative (printed): 4 (Special) + 1D6 (4D6)

Essence -4 (printed). Cybermantic (Cybermancy rules, p.78–84): the sheet shows the printed Essence; the stats are as printed, so apply cybermancy's other effects (+2 × |Essence| to magic against it, CDS) by hand.

Cyberware: all delta grade.

Bioware: Cerebral Booster (Level II) (cultured); Mnemonic Enhancer (Level IV) (cultured)

Cyberware: Commlink IV; Crypto Circuit 10; Cyberarms (left/right: Strength +4, Quickness +6, Body +2); Cyberlimb Cyberdeck (MPCP 8, Hardening +6, Persona 8, Increased Response +3, Internal Memory 1,200 Mp); Fingertip Compartment; Fingertip Datajack; Tactical Computer (Level 4, w. Orientation System); Cybercomm Link; Cyberears (High- and Low-Frequency, Recorder); Cybereyes (Camera, Eye Light System w/BrightLight, Low-Light, Rangefinder, Thermographic, Flare Compensation); Cyberskull; Datajack (Head); Invoked Memory Stimulator; Skillwire (Small-Unit Tactics, Rating 9); Smartlink II; Subdermal Speakers; Subvocal Microphones

Gear: Ares Alpha Combat Guns (2, w/300 rounds APDS ammo, Level II Smartlink, Improved Gas Vent III, 8 IPE offensive and 8 IPE defensive grenades); Ares MP-LMG (w/300 rounds APDS ammo, Laser Tracker, Improved Gas Vent III); Wallacher Combat Axes (2); Additional gear as appropriate

Note: Initiative prints "4 (Special)": the tactical computer's Initiative rules apply (Shadowtech p.53). The book spells "Orientaion".

Threat/Professional Rating: 9/4

Cybertechnology (FASA 7119), Chrome Kings p.92.
